rows.title: Task-queue feature baseline still specifies the obsolete success banner and unfinished badge
rows.body:
A `contract` child of #1625.

Task-queue feature baseline still specifies the obsolete success banner and unfinished badge

Ticket #1625 Read first names `.agents/skills/verify-parrot/features/task-queue.md` as a baseline. Its Sub-features section says `批次结束显示「✓ 批次完成 — 成功 a · 失败 b · 取消 c」` and `导航上的角标是未完成批次数。` These contradict #1625 What to build 3 and 4 and #1618 Implementation Decisions section 8, which require an outcome-specific end banner and a badge counting only processing batches.

The feature's history, per-job progress, cancel/retry, summary navigation, output-folder action and e2e recipe remain valid and must be preserved. The worker will implement the explicit ticket and spec requirements and leave the protected verification feature file unchanged. Please reconcile these two feature descriptions with the settled outcome rules. No answer is required to continue implementation.

rows.title: Ticket #1626 CHECK commands suppress the EXPECT summary
rows.body:
A `contract` child of #1626.

Ticket #1626 CHECK commands suppress the EXPECT summary

AC1 through AC4 use `uv run pytest ... -q -k ...` and require `EXPECT: /^1 passed in /m`.

The repository pyproject.toml already adds `-q`. Running the exact AC3 command exits 0 but prints only `. [100%]`, with no passing summary. AC1, AC2 and AC4 will also deselect their sibling tests, so even one quiet flag prints `1 passed, N deselected in ...`, not `1 passed in ...`.

Please change CHECK commands to exact pytest node IDs without the extra `-q`, retaining the behavioral tests and EXPECT regex. For example `uv run pytest tests/billing/test_parrot_erase_only_billing.py::test_erase_only_hold_preholds_only_the_erasure_surcharge`. AC3 likewise uses its exact node ID. No product requirement needs to change. The worker will leave the test runner and published criteria unchanged and continue implementing billing.
